fields.description: Farm Grove is a four- and five-bedroom villa neighbourhood in The Valley, planned around Ghaf trees, gardens and shared outdoor spaces. Its collection includes both detached and semi-detached homes. A community centre, farming allotments and recreation areas give the development a distinct emphasis on everyday life outdoors.

research.community: The Valley · original Farm Grove release
overview: The brochure pairs contemporary façades with natural tones and large windows. Shared amenities include garden spaces, lawns, a pool-facing fitness facility and places for children to play. Personalising a garden or adding a pool is discussed as an option, so rendered outdoor features should not be assumed to form part of the purchase specification.

The original cluster plan distributes neighbourhood parks and sports courts between residential streets. It also identifies a community centre, local retail, a mosque and a guardhouse. Compare a selected plot with this plan to understand its relationship to shared spaces and access roads.
research.locationNote: Farm Grove is within The Valley on the Dubai–Al Ain Road corridor. Its marketing setting is suburban and landscape-led; check practical driving routes, school access and the delivery of wider-community facilities for your household.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently displays AED 4.8m. The December 2024 fact sheet contains lower launch references for some types. Historical launch terms are shown separately and do not establish today’s available stock or asking price.
research.paymentNote: Launch payments are 10% initially, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Later stages are linked to construction. Obtain the unit’s actual paid-to-date statement and contractual remaining schedule.
research.handoverNote: December 2028 is the estimated completion in the launch payment document and Property Finder. It is not a guaranteed handover date or confirmation of present construction progress.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The fact sheet totals 482 villas: 91 four-bedroom standalone, 48 five-bedroom standalone, 68 semi-detached and 275 other detached homes. These are launch counts.

facts.label: Standalone launch references
facts.value: Four bedrooms: plots 5,081–8,736 sq ft, from AED 6.68m. Five bedrooms: plots 6,646–11,291 sq ft, from AED 7.83m.

facts.label: Other four-bedroom launch references
facts.value: Semi-detached: plots 3,229–6,604 sq ft, from AED 4.44m. Detached: plots 3,229–6,075 sq ft, from AED 4.62m.

facts.label: Layout and inclusions
facts.value: Plans span three levels. Larger standalone layouts show lifts and maid’s rooms; smaller types label a linen room. Pools drawn on the larger plans are explicitly marked as not provided.

facts.label: Size basis
facts.value: Plan totals include suite, garage and balcony/terrace components; plot sizes describe separate land areas.
